error.io: A file could not be read or written
error.not_a_workspace: There is no workspace in this folder
error.locked: This workspace is already open in another window of the app
error.version: The workspace was made by a different version of the app
error.worker: The engine could not be started
error.busy: The engine is busy with another job

action.pick_input: Choose the folder with the scans

failure.input: A scan could not be read.
failure.too_few: An assembly needs at least two fragments.
failure.disk: The result could not be written — the disk may be full.
failure.gpu: The graphics card gave up. On the CPU a run is slower but usually gets to the end.
failure.protocol: The window and the engine are of different versions — reinstall the app.
failure.internal: An internal error in the engine.
failure.crashed: The assembly process crashed — it may have run out of memory.

sheet.title: Assembling the collection
sheet.preset_thorough_hint: match twice with different seeds and keep only what both runs agreed on; about twice the time
sheet.no_adapter: No graphics card found — the assembly will run on the CPU
sheet.estimate_none: An estimate will appear a minute into the run — this is the first assembly on this machine ({{pairs}}).
sheet.out_of_range: The value has to be between {{min}} and {{max}}.

seed.label: Seed
seed.hint: Seed of every random draw: the three per-fragment samplers, the coarse probe and the partner search. Another seed lays the collection out slightly differently.

target_faces.label: Faces in the working mesh
target_faces.hint: How many faces of each scan survive into the matching. Full resolution goes only into the refinement.

tiers.label: Confidence bands
tiers.hint: Probe every accepted join once more and sort the joins into bands; only the confirmed band is assembled. Costs about half a run again.

agree_seeds.label: Agreeing runs
agree_seeds.hint: How many independent runs at different seeds have to confirm a join at the same placement. 0 and 1 are off; 2 is “Thorough”.

thick_ratio.label: Wall-thickness ratio
thick_ratio.hint: A pair is skipped when the two wall thicknesses differ by more than this factor.

min_tight.label: Tight contact, minimum
min_tight.hint: The tight-contact fraction below which a join is not accepted.

max_gap.label: Fracture gap, maximum
max_gap.hint: The median fracture gap, in wall thicknesses; the pair's limit is the larger of k·t and the scan's resolution.

min_seam.label: Seam length, minimum
min_seam.hint: The shortest shared seam, in wall thicknesses.

max_pen.label: Penetration, maximum
max_pen.hint: The penetrating surface fraction above which a join is not accepted.

workers.label: Threads
workers.hint: Worker threads. 0 means one per core minus one.

memory_gb.label: Memory, GB
memory_gb.hint: Gigabytes the scans may occupy at once during preprocessing. Empty means half of the machine's memory.

input.pending: The preview is still being made
input.pick_fragment: Choose a fragment on the left
input.fragment_pending: Fragment {{name}} has not been prepared yet
input.exclude_note: The file is not touched: this is a mark in the workspace.

warning.thickness_outlier: The wall is {{thickness}} against the collection's median of {{median}} ({{percent}}). This may be a base, a handle, or a fragment of another vessel.
warning.thickness_outlier_alone: The wall is {{thickness}}. This may be a base, a handle, or a fragment of another vessel.
warning.not_watertight: The mesh is not closed. The program cannot confirm this fragment's joins by itself — they have to be accepted by hand.

run.remaining_soon: a time estimate will appear shortly
run.cancel_body: The pairs already matched will not be kept.
run.menu: What to do with this run
run.delete_body: The run's folder will be moved to the trash.

banner.input_missing: The folder with the scans is unavailable: it has moved, or its disk is disconnected.
banner.stale: The input has changed since this assembly: {{diff}}
banner.cancelled: This run was stopped by hand.
banner.interrupted: This run was interrupted: the app closed while it was going.
banner.run_unreadable: This run's files cannot be read.

drop.title: Drop a folder of scans here, or choose one

viewer.failed: The model could not be loaded: {{message}}

assembly.unreadable: This run's assembly could not be read
assembly.colour_hint: The C key cycles through them
assembly.review_later: Accepting or rejecting a join comes with the Review mode.
